fit.note: two coils share the window width: (ws - 2 x (former 2.5 + spacer 1.5 mm) - 4 mm) / 2 each

insulation.system: basic winding - core/PE (DC-side system, 1000 V DC, OVC II): 2.5 mm GF-PPS formers, 5 mm creepage margins at the coil ends, VPI (void-free) - PD-free at 1.5 x 1.0 kV peak; turn-to-turn for 1050 V steps at 60 V/ns: 0.13 mm polyimide/Nomex interlayer (foil) or served litz + 0.05 mm film; the switch-node end of each coil on the outer layer with one extra wrap
insulation.routine_tests: winding-core AC 2.2 kV rms 1 s (60 s type), PD <= 10 pC at 1.5 kV pk; L at 0 A and at 300 A DC bias; R_dc
insulation.type_tests: impulse 6 kV 1.2/50; L(I) to 450 A (pulsed); thermal run at 198 A + 32 kHz ripple in the duct air

core.formula: iGSE on the triangular ripple flux dB(theta) = V_dc/(4 f N Ae) (1 - m^2 sin^2 theta), duty 0.5 (1 + m sin theta), averaged over the fundamental, x cut factor; + 50 Hz major loop

winding.formula: P_cu = R_dc I_50^2 + sum R(f) I_f^2; HF rms split 75/20/5 % at f_sw / 2 f_sw / 3 f_sw (ASSUMED)

thermal.airflow: 3 x AFB1224SHE-F00: 149 m3/h per heatsink section; the inductors sit downstream of the heatsink in the same duct (pcs_spec), so the air reaching them is pre-heated by the section's semiconductor loss (463 W -> +10.0 K); h = 25 W/m2K on the exposed coil and core surfaces (about 4 m/s past a 0.1 m body, ASSUMED - the duct section around the inductors is not drawn)

notes.neutral_inductor: Four-wire L_N: same electrical requirement as L1 (pcs_spec LN_four_wire) - same part. Its 50 Hz current is the zero-sequence sum (about 0 A balanced, 216 A at 100 % unbalance), so its copper loss is lower than L1's in normal operation; its HF current depends on the four-wire modulation (if the three phases' common-mode ripple returns through L_N it carries about 3 x 13 A rms at 32 kHz and needs its own design) - converter engineer to state
notes.common_mode_ripple: 13.0 of the 13.9 A rms HF current in L1 is common mode (C_f star tied to the DC midpoint). With the DM part only (4.9 A rms) the recommended L1's copper loss at 198 A / 950 V would be 92 W instead of 178 W; the core loss is set by the leg voltage and does not change
notes.amorphous_loss: The amorphous options use Metglas' 20-50 kHz fit quoted from memory (Yunlu's amorphous C-core curve is an image); OpenMagnetics (MAS 2605SA1) gives about 0.6 x that - the design takes the higher
notes.flux_driver: Core size is set by the hardware-trip requirement L(450 A) >= 50 % (flux linkage 1.05 L x 450 A below B_sat at 100 C), not by the ripple: with a tape core that saturates sharply the 450 A point must stay below the knee

sensitivity_basis: each L re-optimised on the same grid and rules (ripple and HF current x 120.0/L, the L(I) minima x L/120.0, same 450 A trip; 'recommended' = cheapest within 2 x the superseded 57 W budget at 180 A / 750 V); the file's part is the study's selection
